_doc: The supervisor's schedule (assistant/sage.py serve): the jobs that used to be separate scheduled tasks, each on its own cadence. every_min or at (HH:MM once a day); window [start_hour, end_hour] in local time (decimals allowed); windows_only for the PowerShell wrappers; even_paused runs while `sage pause` holds the rest; expect = a last-line prefix a clean run must print; builtin = done inside sage.py. `python` is the interpreter running serve. The zero-LLM spine (assistant/spine_jobs.json) keeps its own job list; serve only fires it.

jobs.name: relay-poll
jobs._what: card taps and dialogs fetched from the Apps Script relay's web app (pull mode, no Tailscale); exits at once without relay_webapp_url in gchat.local.json

jobs.name: engine-update
jobs._what: once a night: a newer engine release (org.json engine_release_url) is downloaded, sha-checked, gated in a staging folder (compile, doctor, the engine's own tests) and applied with engine.update; pack files never touched; the previous engine kept for `sage rollback`; serve restarts itself after (assistant/data/.sage_restart). Exits UPDATER skipped where no release URL is set
